# Calibration Requirements Quality Checklist: Per-device calibration of the recognition

**Purpose**: validate that the written requirements of spec 013 (spec, plan, tasks, contracts) are complete, clear, consistent and measurable before implementation. Standard depth, for the product owner as reviewer.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [tasks.md](../tasks.md), [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command. It tests the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete. The implementation reads the state of this file; it never changes a marker.

## The flow and the window

- [x] CHK001 Is every step of the calibration (offer, tuning, advice, piece, listening, quality, analysis, result, choice) written with what the player sees and what each button does, in one place? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002..FR-006, contracts/calibration-flow.md]
- [x] CHK002 Is "one window whose content changes" specific enough to test: what stays the same between steps, how the current step is shown, and what closing the window does at each step? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK003 Is the condition under which the owner's trial sends the steps back to separate windows written as a decision rule, or only as "to be tried"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, Tasks T044]
- [x] CHK004 Is the offer *Calibrate / Use the default configuration* described the same way for a never-calibrated, a calibrated and a red device in the spec, the contract and the tasks? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, contracts/calibration-flow.md, Tasks T032]
- [x] CHK005 Is "about the number of sounds of the piece" turned into an exact rule (what counts as one sound, the 250 ms refractory time, the 1 s after the last expected sound, the 20 s and 3 min timeouts)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, research R4]
- [x] CHK006 Are all refusal causes (wrong number of sounds, silent, too short, too noisy, clipped, timeout, "not good enough") listed with a reason text each and the same three choices? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, contracts/calibration-flow.md]
- [x] CHK007 Are the thresholds that make a recording "too noisy", "too short" or "clipped" quantified, or left to the implementation? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK008 Is what the quality question shows (the measures) and what the player is supposed to conclude from them defined, given that there is no replay? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK009 Is the behaviour of "stop" defined at every step, including during the analysis (cancel latency, what is shown while stopping)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, contracts/calibration-flow.md]
- [x] CHK010 Is *Forget the calibration* specified fully: when it is enabled, the confirmation text, what is deleted, and what the dot becomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK011 Are the tuning question's "No" path (the tuner opens and the calibration does not go on) and the way back from the tuner written as a requirement, not only in the contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]

## The profile, the dot and where it applies

- [x] CHK012 Is the list of settings a profile may hold stated in the spec with the settings that never change (pitch engine, tuner's own, passages, timing window, flames, gain), or only in the plan? [Traceability, Spec Assumptions, research R2]
- [x] CHK013 Is the key of a profile (device, channel) and its extra checks (sample rate, front-end state) written once and consistently in the spec, the plan and the data model? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK014 Is it defined what happens when a profile's sample rate differs from the capture rate, and is that case distinct in wording from the changed noise-reduction or gain case? [Clarity, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK015 Are all dot states (grey, orange, green, red) defined with their text, their colour-independent label, and the rule for the 60 % boundary (is exactly 60 % green)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK016 Is the warning sentence for a changed noise reduction or gain defined (when it appears, its text, whether it is removed when the setting returns)? [Gap, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK017 Is it stated that the profile applies to the tuner window and to Follow, Arcade and Wait, and which of the tuner's parameters are explicitly outside the profile? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK018 Is the moment a profile becomes active defined for application start (remembered input), for an input change, and for a device that appears later? [Coverage, research R1, contracts/profile-library.md]
- [x] CHK019 Is the statement "no special handling of an input change during an exercise" consistent with the rule that the dot "changes at once" and with the engine rebuilding its analysis? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK020 Is the Configuration window's relation to profiles written for all three actions (edit, restore defaults, save while a profile is active)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, research R1]

## The scoring and the search

- [x] CHK021 Is the recognition rate defined as a formula (events accepted over events of the piece, total, notes and chords) in the spec and not only in the contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, contracts/scoring-search.md]
- [x] CHK022 Is "better than the default" defined in the spec (the objective, the one-event gain) so the owner can judge it, rather than left in the plan? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014, contracts/scoring-search.md]
- [x] CHK023 Is the interaction of the two rules (better than the default, and total rate at least 60 %) written for all four combinations, including the colour of the resulting dot? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK024 Is the purpose of the negative control stated in terms the owner can accept, and is the weight (2 x wrong) justified or marked as a choice? [Assumption, research R5]
- [x] CHK025 Is determinism a stated requirement with its test (same recording, same piece, same profile), including the order of parameters and the tie rule? [Measurability, contracts/scoring-search.md]
- [x] CHK026 Are the budget (120 s, 2000 candidates), the progress figure and the cancel written as requirements with what the player sees when the budget ends before the search converges? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK027 Is the risk of over-fitting one short recording stated in the spec, with the independent measure that answers it, and is the "no gain promised" rule visible to the player and not only in the reports? [Coverage, research R6, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK028 Is the number of events of the piece (25 notes, an unconfirmed number of events) fixed before the 60 % and the one-event gain are interpreted, given that one event is a large share of a short piece? [Ambiguity, research R10, Tasks T002]

## Data safety and non-regression

- [x] CHK029 Is "no audio on disk" written as a testable requirement (what is checked, where), including the temporary directory and crash cases? [Measurability, Spec §FR-017, Tasks T025]
- [x] CHK030 Is the wording of the spec ("deleted after the analysis") consistent with the plan ("never written, only dropped from memory"), and does the owner accept the stricter reading? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, research R4]
- [x] CHK031 Are the moments a profile is written listed exhaustively (only a finished choice, never before) and the failure of the write itself (disk full, read-only file) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK032 Is the restart behaviour of the library specified for a corrupt, missing, older-version and newer-version file, with the dot each case gives? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK033 Is "with no profile every figure is unchanged" tied to a named set of reports and a comparison rule (equal to what precision)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK034 Are the real writers of the recognition store named in the plan and the tasks, and is there a rule for any future writer (a test that fails when one reads the effective settings to write them)? [Traceability, research R1, Tasks T011]
- [x] CHK035 Is the behaviour defined when two copies of the application, or two windows of the calibration, touch the same library at once? [Gap, Edge Cases]

## Validation honesty

- [x] CHK036 Are the three measures (the calibration recording, the 22-note corpus, the owner's chord takes) each tied to a success criterion with what is compared and what counts as a failure to report? [Traceability, Spec §SC-005, §SC-006, Tasks T023, T042]
- [x] CHK037 Is it stated that the 22-note corpus and the owner's recording may not be used to choose search settings, to protect the independent measure? [Assumption, research R9, Tasks T042]
- [x] CHK038 Is what the headless tests cannot see (the real window, the real microphone, the feel of the one window, the 5-minute duration) listed with the owner's trial as the only check? [Coverage, Spec §SC-001, Tasks T044]
- [x] CHK039 Is the success criterion SC-006 written so that it can fail (a threshold or a rule), or only so that something is "measured and reported"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK040 Is the scope of the validation limited honestly to the built-in microphone and one guitar (no claim for other microphones, interfaces, bass or other computers)? [Assumption, Spec §FR-018, Assumptions]

## Added after the decision on noise (2026-10-15)

- [x] CHK041 CHK006 and CHK007 above were written before it was decided that the background noise is only **measured and shown**: do they still describe the refusal causes (now wrong number of sounds, silent, clipped, timeout, "not good enough") and is the absence of a noise threshold acceptable to the owner? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK042 Is it written how the player is helped to judge the background noise at the quality question (what is shown, in what unit, compared to what), given that no threshold decides for them? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]

## Notes

- Check items off as you review: `[x]`. Add comments or findings inline; number new items continuing from CHK043.
- Items that fail point to a requirement to write or sharpen in the spec, the plan or the tasks before `/speckit-implement`.
